title: Video Content Creation With AI | Saylani Mass IT Training
text: Course: Video Content Creation With AI. Category: Designing. Duration: 4 months. Description: Helps students become professional AI-powered content creators and video editors, combining storytelling, video production, AI scripting, editing, audio enhancement, and social media optimization. This course is offered free of cost by Saylani Mass IT Training (SMIT), an initiative of Saylani Welfare International Trust. Admission is via the online registration form at https://www.saylanimit.com/enroll, selecting this course and a preferred campus/city.
